# Town of Moretown municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# held-straggler sweep; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Moretown Memorial Library, Board of Trustees minutes, March 17, 2026: 'Pam Barnes and April Shaw were elected to one-year terms. Sybil Schlesinger was elected to a 3-year term.' Barnes and Schlesinger already hold memberships (renewals); Shaw, who also acts as trustee/chair in the minutes of May 12, 2026, is the one new holder, completing the five-member board.
